summary: The provided source is an FCC fact sheet announcing a Notice of Proposed Rulemaking and Further Notice of Proposed Rulemaking concerning the E‑Rate program, outlining areas for comment such as narrowing the program, improving student learning outcomes, protecting children’s online safety, and strengthening program integrity. No stakeholder positions or arguments are present in the text. No explicit policy claims identified in the provided source spans. The comment proposes a suite of reforms to strengthen oversight of E‑Rate consultants, including a formal definition, annual certification, a registration database, prohibition of percentage‑based fee arrangements, and enhanced record‑keeping requirements. The comment proposes a new consultant certification and disclosure form for the E‑Rate program, arguing it will deter misconduct, improve transparency, and help enforcement agencies. It also seeks guidance on timing and scope of the form. The comment proposes a comprehensive consultant registration and training program for the E‑Rate process, including individual consultant identification numbers, mandatory annual training, expanded data collection, and privacy safeguards.
